conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body; if (body.action !== 'created') return false; const isIssueComment = !!body.issue; const isReviewComment = !isIssueComment && !!body.comment && !!body.pull_request; if (isIssueComment && !body.issue.pull_request) return false; if (body.sender && body.sender.type === 'Bot') return false; const botLogins = ($env.N8N_BOT_LOGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (botLogins.includes(body.sender && body.sender.login)) return false; const commenter = body.comment && body.comment.user && body.comment.user.login; if (botLogins.includes(commenter)) return false; const text = ((body.comment && body.comment.body) || '').trim(); if (/^\/(build|merge|review)\b/i.test(text)) return false; return true; })() }}

parameters.command:
=set +e
set -o pipefail
PR={{ $json.prNumber }}
BRANCH="{{ $json.branch }}"
CID="{{ $json.commentId }}"
cd ~/workspace || exit 10
_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)
_T="${_URL#*x-access-token:}"
export GH_TOKEN="${_T%%@*}"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH" 2>&1
git checkout "$BRANCH" 2>&1
git reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH" 2>&1
PROMPT="/tmp/fix-$PR-$CID.txt"
echo {{ $json.promptB64 }} | base64 -d > "$PROMPT"
claude --print < "$PROMPT"
CLAUDE_RC=$?
rm -f "$PROMPT"
echo "CLAUDE_RC=$CLAUDE_RC"
if git diff --quiet "origin/$BRANCH..HEAD"; then
  echo "NO_CHANGES=1"
  exit 0
fi
git push origin "HEAD:$BRANCH" 2>&1
PUSH_RC=$?
echo "PUSH_RC=$PUSH_RC"
NEW_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "NEW_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
exit 0

parameters.body: ={{ (() => { const out = $json.stdout || ''; const noChanges = /NO_CHANGES=1/.test(out); const pushRc = (out.match(/PUSH_RC=(\d+)/) || [])[1]; const newSha = (out.match(/NEW_SHA=([a-f0-9]+)/) || [])[1]; const cid = $('Normalize').item.json.commentId; if (noChanges) return `agent ran on comment ${cid} but produced no changes.`; if (pushRc && pushRc !== '0') return `agent addressed comment ${cid} but push failed (rc=${pushRc}) — see workflow logs.`; if (newSha) return `addressed in \`${newSha.slice(0,7)}\` (comment ${cid}).`; return `agent finished comment ${cid} — see workflow logs.`; })() }}
